property_summary: For every call to transfer(from,caddress,_tos,v) the reference contract always reverts if _tos.length == 0 (i.e. it never returns true for an empty recipients array); the mutant replaces that check with require(v>0) so it can return true for empty _tos when v>0, violating the rule.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require v > 0 so calls with empty _tos no longer revert but zero-value transfers are prevented.
